messages:
maria.gonzalez: Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD for the Optimize Guidance toolkit (batching, caching, quant). Customers keep asking for prescriptive "presets" and launch expectations.
chris.lee: SGTM. Can we separate "recommendations" from automatic enforcement? Customers want guidance first, opt-in automation later.
devin.parker: +1. Acceptance criteria idea: (1) docs + presets published, (2) 2 customer pilot integrations, (3) perf benchmarks showing >=15% token cost reduction without >10% latency regression.
anya.ivanova: Edge cases — streaming chat workflows with long context. Batching/caching heuristics might break token attribution. Need explicit compatibility matrix.
samir.khan: For quantization recommendations: provide per-model safe options (e.g., fp16 -> int8+per-layer) and a small eval harness to flag quality regressions.
maria.gonzalez: Drafted acceptance criteria snippet:
```
- Presets: low-latency, cost-saver, high-throughput
- Each preset has: default batch size, KV cache TTL, quant recommendation, expected perf delta
- QA: run on 3 representative workloads (chat, summarization, embeddings)
- Rollout gating: pilot customers >=2 & no regressions on eval set
```
chris.lee: How do we measure "no regressions"? We should define thresholds per metric (e.g., ROUGE/BLEU, KL-divergence, human eval flags). Also budget for false positives.
devin.parker: Suggest adding runbook for failure modes: auto-fallback to previous quant/model, disable batching per-route, and telemetry tags to trace token-level anomalies.
anya.ivanova: Scope negotiation: MVP should focus on recommendations + docs + a CLI/SDK flag to "apply preset". Defer auto-tuning and automatic re-quantization to v2.
maria.gonzalez: Prioritization matrix I propose: customer demand x engineering cost. Top candidates: (A) batching presets (B) cache TTL rules (C) quant recommendations. Order: A -> C -> B? Thoughts?
samir.khan: I'd do A -> B -> C. C has more risk (quality regressions) and needs eval infra.
maria.gonzalez: Noted. Final ask: folks review the PRD draft by EOD Friday. I'll attach perf slices and a small eval plan. @deploy-bot please post a reminder on Friday 9am.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled for Friday 09:00 UTC — "Review PRD: Optimize Guidance (batching/caching/quant)" :bell:
chris.lee: I'll add a short acceptance checklist in the doc. Also pinging sales for customer pilot candidates.
